item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Native disaster recovery for Azure Functions durable task scheduler
item.description:
Azure Functions durable task scheduler now has public preview disaster recovery for the Dedicated SKU in supported Azure regions. It lets you recover workflow orchestration state after a regional outage without rebuilding it.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Task Queues for Azure Functions durable task scheduler
item.description:
Task Queues for Azure Functions durable task scheduler are in public preview. They let workloads sharing a task hub use named queues so you can separate throughput needs and downstream service limits.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Customer-managed keys for Azure Functions durable task scheduler
item.description:
Customer-managed keys for Azure Functions Durable Task Scheduler are now generally available for Dedicated SKU schedulers. This lets organizations use their own keys to encrypt workflow data.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Private endpoints for Azure Functions durable task scheduler
item.description:
Private endpoints for Azure Functions durable task scheduler are now generally available. This supports both Dedicated and Consumption SKU schedulers, allowing Azure Functions and other durable task SDK workloads to connect to the scheduler over a private IP address.

  • Source: Azure Updates
